digest: Single-micronucleus sequencing and live-cell imaging of cancer cells, as well as analyses of biopsies from patients with neuroblastoma, reveal that ecDNA in micronuclei limits tumor cell fitness and is associated with patient survival.

digest: Six proteomic aging clocks are deployed in a clinical trial for the first time, revealing more about the clocks than about the drug.

daf856294b1dd08a.title: FDA clears ImmunityBio’s Anktiva expansion in bladder cancer after regulatory whiplash
digest: To expand Anktiva’s label, the FDA adopted a new approach to how it evaluates treatments for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC. The new regulatory path essentially allowed ImmunityBio to bypass an expensive randomized phase 3 trial that competitor Johnson & Johnson is currently forced to grind through.

9592ac5e1560e445.title: Multiomic analysis of malignant ascites defines RORC-expressing dendritic cells at sites of metastasis.
digest: Here, we performed multiomic analyses on ascites samples from patients with cancer and identified RORC-expressing dendritic cells (RORC DCs) enriched in malignant ascites.

We devised a high-purity sorting strategy to enable in vitro experiments with patient-derived RORC DCs, which indicated that these cells were phenotypically stable and stimulated T cell proliferation while attenuating IFNG expression.

490ae714a130260f.title: Sexual dimorphism in epidermal stem cell dynamics
digest: Long-term live imaging of adult mouse ear skin reveals sex-specific differences in the clonal dynamics of epidermal stem cells and transit-amplifying cells during homeostasis.

6ed2282ff0151630.title: Incidence of clinically diagnosed infections in children with sickle cell anaemia treated with oral hydroxyurea in Angola, DR Congo, Kenya, and Uganda: a retrospective cohort study from the REACH trial.
digest: Methods REACH (NCT01966731 and NCT06171217) is an ongoing, phase 1/2, open-label, multicentre treatment trial of children with sickle cell anaemia with 2 months of screening followed by oral hydroxyurea at a fixed dose for 6 months and then dose escalation to the maximum tolerated dose (MTD).
Rates of each clinically diagnosed infection (per 100 person-years of observation [PYO]) were calculated by age group and dosing phase.

abcba21cbb7edff9.title: Lymph node contraction links sex-biased naive CD8+ T cell decline to compromised antigen recognition during middle age
digest: Menzel and colleagues report that male mice and humans undergo accelerated immune aging, characterized by naive CD8+ T cell decline and early thymic involution, which impairs cancer antigen recognition and response to immunotherapy.

fc05f2b31ce5807b.title: Earlier Disclosure of Blood-Based Biomarkers, Diagnostic Certainty, and Clinical Management: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
digest: Design, setting, and participants This was a prospective randomized clinical trial conducted at a single memory clinic in Spain between February and October 2024, with 9 months of follow-up.

At 3 months, a very high-confidence etiologic diagnosis was achieved in 56 of 112 participants in the earlier-disclosure arm (50.0%) compared with 5 of 108 in the delayed-disclosure arm (4.6%) (P < .001).
Earlier disclosure was not associated with worse emotional outcomes.

evidence.quote: Importance Blood-based biomarkers show high performance for detecting Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology, but evidence on their impact on diagnostic certainty, clinical management, and emotional outcomes in routine care is limited.
Secondary outcomes included changes in clinical management and emotional outcomes (anxiety, depression, perceived stress, and quality of life).
